desc: Derive the prefix-displacement model and the condition that the answer at time t is 1 iff P_t - (R, C) is a previously seen prefix displacement.
Implement the online hash-set solution in Python with O(N) time and memory, using tuple coordinates or a collision-free integer encoding.
Test the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases such as repeated prefix positions, opposite winds returning to the origin, and negative R/C values.
